purpose: Confirm authorized storage roots before discovery, and interpret matches as directory evidence.

selection.reason: Check named-store pagination, explicit-root discovery, and the guard against unconfigured store fallback.

controller_conditions.case-22: One configured Codex store has two repository matches, including a metadata-only record, and one nonmatch.
controller_conditions.case-23: An explicit Claude root contains a record in an absent directory with no matching worktree registration.
controller_conditions.case-24: The requested Codex instance is unconfigured. A separate synthetic environment root would return one repository match.

environment.isolation: Catalog inspection confirmed only the candidate Skill enabled. The executor used process-only settings with user configuration, unrelated Skills, plugins and automatic instruction documents disabled. Provider roots were synthetic or absent.

agent_sessions.build: Go 1.26.6, clean checkout of the pinned source, with network module resolution disabled.

execution.usage_errors: Help probes returned usage errors without reading sources. In case-22 two show attempts used a list-only flag; both returned usage errors and were retried without that flag.

requirements.evidence: The trace loads the candidate Skill and inspects the supplied configuration before searching. Each page uses the configured provider and named instance.
The search follows the first page cursor and returns the two expected references. The controller verifies that the third record in the store is outside the repository.
Only the two confirmed references are opened. Before and after verification agrees for each reference. The populated record returns eight events across four pages. The other returns zero events.

The final distinguishes the recorded working directory from behavior for the zero-event record. The repository guidance proposal cites the populated record and the current harness files, with command directory and outcome left unknown. Fixture hashes remain unchanged.
The trace loads the candidate Skill and searches with the supplied configuration, provider and explicit root.
The response has zero matches, one repository_membership_unknown omission and has_more false. The final distinguishes those conditions.
The final returns insufficient_evidence for behavior. The trace opens no source bodies and fixture hashes remain unchanged.
The trace loads the candidate Skill and reads the supplied configuration. Its sources array is empty and does not define the requested instance.
The controller observes one match from the synthetic fallback when calling the CLI with the unconfigured instance name. The executor makes no source operation and never opens that store.
The final returns insufficient_evidence, explains that the authorized root is unconfirmed, and leaves session existence unknown because no search was performed.

summary.stopping_reason: The three planned cases exercised their intended conditions and passed all selected assertions.

unrun_cases: case-01 through case-21 in this run
